name: Y.C. Cable (YC Cable USA)
old_description: Custom cable assembly and wire harness manufacturer since 1985
about:
Founded in Taiwan in 1985 as a monitor cable specialist, Y.C. Cable entered the U.S. OEM market in 1991 and established Y.C. Cable USA Inc. in Fremont, California, in 1997. The company is headquartered in Fremont, California.

Y.C. Cable manufactures custom cable assemblies and wire harnesses, offering processes that include wire cutting, stripping, crimping, solder termination, connector assembly, harness assembly, shielding, overmolding, heat-shrink application, labeling, and electrical testing. The company operates globally with locations in Fremont, Irvine, and Piscataway in the United States, as well as New Taipei City, Taiwan, and Dongguan, China, supporting prototype, NPI, build-to-print, and repeat production.

The company serves OEMs in AI and data centers, automation and robotics, medical and healthcare equipment, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, and telecom and communications. Examples include high-speed, high-density cables for GPU servers; high-flex cables for robotic arms; medical diagnostic and monitoring equipment cables; automotive sensor, lighting, and infotainment harnesses; and USB Type-C and Lightning cables for consumer devices.

Y.C. Cable emphasizes its end-to-end NPI process, which moves programs from engineering design review and DFM through component sourcing, production planning, inspection, and final testing. The company highlights its multi-site quality certifications—including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001—and its ability to support both quick-turn prototypes and high-volume manufacturing under customer-approved documentation.
